vulnerability.explanation: Computes auxptr = flaginfo->outsyms + ((indx - syment_base + 1) * osymesz) and writes an aux entry to it via bfd_coff_swap_aux_out without checking that indx >= syment_base and that the computed position lies within the allocated outsyms buffer. A crafted input causing indx < syment_base or an otherwise out-of-range indx results in a write past the end of flaginfo->outsyms.
